looks_like_me_why: I give 4 because the character has my skin tone, gray hair streaks, the same smile and the gold hoops — I can see me in many pictures. But it is very cartoony and a little younger/niña at times. Close-ups on pages 5-7 and 11-15 show different expressions and look less like my real face. The cover and pages 1, 3, 9 feel most like me.
rings_true_why: The story is the classic Little Red Riding Hood and it reads simple and clear like a real children's cuento. Text matches the pictures, the rhythm and ending are familiar and sweet. It feels like a true kids book.
professional_why: Very polished art, lovely colors, lighting, and composition. It looks like a published book — I would print it and maybe give as a regalo if the personalization is right.
not_good: Some inconsistency with the face across pages (pages 5-7 flower picking and pages 11-15 bedroom/chase scenes), sometimes too childlike or different expressions. Page 10 knock expression is a bit odd. Page 17 wardrobe surprise and Grandma look different style than the protagonist. Small things: earrings or hair sometimes not same, and the wolf is very scary on some pages (might frighten tiny niños).
liked: I liked the warm colors, the red cape and basket, the cozy kitchen and Grandma scene, the woodcutter hero, and the happy ending. The book feels loving and would be special for my futuro nieto.
